The difference $S∖T$ consists of all the elements that are in $S$ but not $T.$ To represent $S∖T,$ we will shade in all the area that is contained in $S$ but not $T.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071857/assets/be1caefc99bea5d4dde0ba272a208dd8f587156029ce37df483e40cd5f6121d2.png)

All elements of $S$ are not in $T.$

Therefore, the difference is

$$
S∖T=\{5,7,9\}.
$$
